taskSuggestions.title:
Away from your computer?
You can still get started.
taskSuggestions.copy: Ask Cindy to work on your computer, and check progress from your phone.
taskSuggestions.footerTitle: What can your computer help with next?
taskSuggestions.footerCopy: Start a new session and follow its progress here.
taskSuggestions.syncHint: Sessions started on your computer will appear here too.

findFile.label: Find a file on your computer
findFile.hint: No need to go back and look for it
findFile.prompt: Help me find a file on this computer. First ask for keywords in its name, its type, or roughly when it was modified, then search and list possible matches.

computerStatus.label: See how busy your computer is
computerStatus.prompt: Check the CPU, memory, and disk usage on this computer, identify resource-heavy programs, and summarize in plain language.

projectProgress.label: Catch up on a project
projectProgress.hint: Review recent changes and remaining work
projectProgress.prompt: Help me catch up on a project on this computer. First let me choose the project, then review recent changes and outstanding work and give me a short summary.

downloads.label: See what is in Downloads
downloads.prompt: Review the files in this computer’s Downloads folder, summarize them by type and date, and suggest how to organize them. Do not move or delete files yet.

summarizeDocument.label: Summarize a long document
summarizeDocument.hint: Get the key points on your phone
summarizeDocument.prompt: Summarize a document on this computer. First ask for its file name or location, then extract the key points, conclusions, and action items.

storageUsage.label: Find what is using disk space
storageUsage.prompt: Analyze disk usage on this computer, list the largest folders and files, and suggest ways to organize them. Do not delete anything yet.
